mapper.sql: select s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, s.supplier_code, s.contact_person, s.contact_phone, s.contact_email, s.address, s.settlement_method, s.cooperation_status, s.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from inv_supplier s left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id
mapper.select: select s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, s.supplier_code, s.contact_person, s.contact_phone, s.contact_email, s.address, s.settlement_method, s.cooperation_status, s.shop_dept_id, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from inv_supplier s inner join sys_dept current_dept on current_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} left join sys_dept supplier_dept on supplier_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id where s.supplier_name = #{supplierName} and s.status = '0' and s.cooperation_status = '0' and ( s.shop_dept_id = current_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(s.shop_dept_id, current_dept.ancestors) ) and (supplier_dept.dept_id is null or (supplier_dept.del_flag = '0' and supplier_dept.status = '0')) order by case when s.shop_dept_id = current_dept.dept_id then 0 else 1 end, length(coalesce(supplier_dept.ancestors, '')) desc, s.supplier_id desc limit 1

select ( (select count(1) from inv_product p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.supplier_name = #{supplierName} and p.shop_dept_id in #{deptId}) + (select count(1) from inv_purchase_order o where (o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} or o.supplier_name = #{supplierName}) and o.shop_dept_id in #{deptId}) + (select count(1) from inv_purchase_return r where r.supplier_name = #{supplierName} and r.shop_dept_id in #{deptId}) ) as reference_count
